failures: Request reinterpreted: the user asked for SLERP scatter plots 'just like what you did for linear distance plots, one for each model' in the report. The linear distance plots in REPORT.md are Figures 1 and 5–8: a separate figure for each model, each with a middle-block panel (a) and a final-block panel (b). What was delivered is one combined five-panel figure in the style of the summary figure (Figure 9), with the final block only plus an extra Spearman panel. It does not match the per-model style of the report's linear plots, and the middle-block SLERP scatters are left out entirely. The Limitations section admits that middle-block widths 'are in the CSVs' only.

The routing note's reading that 'one for each model' means 'one panel per model in a single five-panel figure' and the style of summary_distance_vs_width.png was never confirmed with the user. It is also not the style of the per-model linear scatters the report actually contains. No 'Figure 1/5–8 under SLERP' equivalents were produced.

The 'majority region' rule is questionable for Qwen3. The automatic crop at path length 13.5–49.8 cuts through a still-dense right tail: in Figure 9 the cloud runs right up to the right edge at about 49.8. That is a crop of the distribution itself, not the removal of a few far outliers, and it visually hides part of the upward trend that rho summarizes.

Overclaim in the Summary: 'Rerunning the full sweep with the SLERP path strengthens the positive link ... in every model.' Pythia's straight-line rho was −0.15, so there was no positive link to strengthen, and its SLERP rho of +0.02 is essentially zero. GPT2-XL's +0.10 is also negligible. The Conclusion's 'a weak-to-moderate positive link under SLERP' generalizes over models where there is effectively no link (Pythia +0.02, GPT2-XL +0.10).

Figure readability: in the Spearman panel of the SLERP figure (PNG and PDF), the model tick labels ('GPT-2 Large', 'Pythia 1.4B', 'Llama 3.1-8B') run into the plot area and overlap the markers or reference line. In the Qwen3 panel, the '261 of them outside this x range, not drawn' note sits over the data.
content.summary: Part 1 is done correctly. The Llama panel of summary_distance_vs_width.png/.pdf now shows only the enlarged region D 1.0–2.5, states how many points are not drawn, and its statistics still use every point. Part 2 is not delivered as asked. The user wanted SLERP scatters in the report matching the linear distance plots, one for each model. The report's linear plots are per-model two-panel figures (middle and final block, Figures 1 and 5–8). The work instead adds one combined final-block-only summary figure (Figure 9) and drops the middle-block SLERP view. The Qwen3 crop cuts into dense data rather than a few outliers. The report text overstates the SLERP result as strengthening a positive link 'in every model', though Pythia (−0.15 → +0.02) and GPT2-XL (+0.10) show essentially no link. The new figure's summary panel also has overlapping labels. The full SLERP sweeps, scripts and CSVs look sound, and the report stays within its word (4,997/5,000) and figure (9) budgets, but the main request was reinterpreted, so this fails.
